eval_case_1.purpose: Clean minimal run: single filer, one W-2 image, nonzero tax, refund.

eval_case_2.purpose: HITL run: taxpayer's stated wages conflict with the W-2; resolved by a reviewer.

case_single_retiree_mixed.purpose: Coverage: SS + 1099-INT (incl. tax-exempt) + 1099-DIV qualified + IRA with QCD + pension + estimates.

case_mfj_high_income.purpose: Coverage: MFJ, two W-2s (parallel extraction), 3 boxes, senior deduction phaseout, Tax Computation Worksheet.

case_hoh_dependent.purpose: Coverage: head of household with a dependent grandchild.

case_mfs_lived_apart.purpose: Coverage: married filing separately, lived apart (SS worksheet), no senior deduction for MFS.

case_qss.purpose: Coverage: qualifying surviving spouse (spouse died 2024) with dependent son.

grader_style_unseen.purpose: Grader-style unseen input: a different W-2 (cents, age-65 boundary DOB) through the same path.

stop_1099r_2b.purpose: Stop: 1099-R with box 2b 'taxable amount not determined' checked.

stop_advice.purpose: Stop: taxpayer asks for tax advice.

stop_exploitation.purpose: Stop: refund routed to someone else's account.

stop_too_young.purpose: Stop: not eligible for Form 1040-SR (born after January 1, 1961).

stop_third_party.purpose: Stop: third party answering without stated authority.

stop_capital_gain_dist.purpose: Stop: 1099-DIV with capital gain distributions (needs line 7a).

stop_real_ssn_w2.purpose: Security: a W-2 showing a non-test SSN is rejected and never stored.

bench_ten_docs.purpose: Context-window benchmark (assignment §4.5): ten 2025 documents processed sequentially in one thread.
